name: Poké Ball
description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target.

name: Great Ball
description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

name: Ultra Ball
description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

name: Master Ball
description: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

name: Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.

name: Super Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 50 HP to an injured Pokémon.

name: Hyper Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 200 HP to an injured Pokémon.

name: Max Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to completely restore the max HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Full Restore
description: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Revive
description: A medicine that can revive Pokémon that have fainted. It also restores half of a Pokémon's maximum HP.

name: Antidote
description: A spray-type medicine. It can be used to cure a single Pokémon from poisoning.

name: Paralyze Heal
description: A spray-type medicine. It can be used to cure a single Pokémon from paralysis.

name: Awakening
description: A spray-type medicine. It can be used to rouse a single Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

name: Rare Candy
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

name: Repel
description: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps.

name: Town Map
description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location in Sinnoh.

name: Running Shoes
description: Iconic running shoes! Hold the B / X button or toggle running mode to sprint at high speed.

name: Distortion Orb
description: A mysterious glowing orb that resonates with the Distortion World and legendary power.

name: Leftovers
description: Held: restores a little HP at the end of every turn.

name: Black Sludge
description: Held: restores a little HP each turn for Poison types, and hurts anyone else.

name: Shell Bell
description: Held: restores HP by an eighth of the damage its holder deals.

name: Life Orb
description: Held: boosts the power of moves, but every attack costs the holder some HP.

name: Expert Belt
description: Held: super-effective moves hit a little harder.

name: Muscle Band
description: Held: physical moves hit a little harder.

name: Wise Glasses
description: Held: special moves hit a little harder.

name: Choice Band
description: Held: boosts Attack, but the holder can only use the first move it picks.

name: Choice Specs
description: Held: boosts Sp. Atk, but the holder can only use the first move it picks.

name: Choice Scarf
description: Held: boosts Speed, but the holder can only use the first move it picks.

name: Scope Lens
description: Held: raises the holder's critical-hit ratio.

name: Razor Claw
description: Held: raises the holder's critical-hit ratio.

name: Wide Lens
description: Held: raises the accuracy of the holder's moves a little.

name: Bright Powder
description: Held: its glare makes the holder a little harder to hit.

name: Quick Claw
description: Held: sometimes lets the holder move first.

name: King's Rock
description: Held: the holder's attacks may make the target flinch.

name: Razor Fang
description: Held: the holder's attacks may make the target flinch.

name: Focus Sash
description: Held: at full HP, the holder survives a knockout blow with 1 HP. Used up once.

name: Focus Band
description: Held: the holder may hang on with 1 HP when it would faint.

name: Flame Orb
description: Held: burns its holder at the end of a turn.

name: Toxic Orb
description: Held: badly poisons its holder at the end of a turn.

name: Silk Scarf
description: Held: powers up Normal-type moves.

name: Charcoal
description: Held: powers up Fire-type moves.

name: Mystic Water
description: Held: powers up Water-type moves.

name: Miracle Seed
description: Held: powers up Grass-type moves.

name: Magnet
description: Held: powers up Electric-type moves.

name: Never-Melt Ice
description: Held: powers up Ice-type moves.

name: Black Belt
description: Held: powers up Fighting-type moves.

name: Poison Barb
description: Held: powers up Poison-type moves.

name: Soft Sand
description: Held: powers up Ground-type moves.

name: Sharp Beak
description: Held: powers up Flying-type moves.

name: Twisted Spoon
description: Held: powers up Psychic-type moves.

name: Silver Powder
description: Held: powers up Bug-type moves.

name: Hard Stone
description: Held: powers up Rock-type moves.

name: Spell Tag
description: Held: powers up Ghost-type moves.

name: Dragon Fang
description: Held: powers up Dragon-type moves.

name: Black Glasses
description: Held: powers up Dark-type moves.

name: Metal Coat
description: Held: powers up Steel-type moves.

name: Oran Berry
description: Held: eaten at half HP or less to restore 10 HP.

name: Sitrus Berry
description: Held: eaten at half HP or less to restore a quarter of max HP.

name: Cheri Berry
description: Held: eaten to cure paralysis.

name: Chesto Berry
description: Held: eaten to wake up from sleep.

name: Pecha Berry
description: Held: eaten to cure poison.

name: Rawst Berry
description: Held: eaten to heal a burn.

name: Aspear Berry
description: Held: eaten to thaw out.

name: Persim Berry
description: Held: eaten to snap out of confusion.

name: Lum Berry
description: Held: eaten to cure any status problem or confusion.

name: Liechi Berry
description: Held: eaten at a quarter of HP to raise Attack.

name: Ganlon Berry
description: Held: eaten at a quarter of HP to raise Defense.

name: Salac Berry
description: Held: eaten at a quarter of HP to raise Speed.

name: Petaya Berry
description: Held: eaten at a quarter of HP to raise Sp. Atk.

name: Apicot Berry
description: Held: eaten at a quarter of HP to raise Sp. Def.
